camera_method: Assumed plausible offset camera with shifted principal point; image rays used to derive exterior component placement. Rejected unconstrained camera fits yielding below-ground camera.
observed_features: Two principal sash window tiers, six-over-six glazing
Four frontal Ionic columns and side returns
Pedimented north portico, alternating segmental and triangular window hoods
Roof balustrades, attic screen, chimneys, flagpole
assumptions: Absolute size is not surveyed. Nominal sash height sets approximate scale.
Main depth 23 m, rear and side openings, flat concealed roof, attic depth and slab elevations inferred.
Rear repeats observed sash language with simplified frames; no interiors, furniture, rooms, stairs or hidden services.
Ionic scrolls, stone profiles and dentils are simplified at photograph resolution.
The rectangular entrance fanlight glazing is screened by an arched stone surround; its exact historic joinery is unverified.
Ground level is obscured. Garden and fountain are approximate decorative render context, excluded from IFC.

detail_policy.shared_geometry: 201 mapped IFC items; 341 rendered semantic occurrences use 140 unique meshes before final refinement. Sash, surround, columns, capitals, hoods and side balusters share geometry.
detail_policy.not_observed: No curtain walls; facade glazing is modelled as windows in masonry.
detail_policy.omitted: Unseen interiors and subpixel historic ornament.
detail_policy.side_balusters: Individual repeated posts are IfcMember; grouped front/rear panels and copings are IfcRailing.

evidence_limits.silhouette_mask: Not annotated because trees and shrubs occlude the envelope.
evidence_limits.photographic_validation: Separate from IFC validity; only fixed landmark projection is scored.

refinement: Upper sash height revised from 2.7 to 2.6 m; camera roll reduced 0.143 degrees and principal point raised 2 pixels, guided by unchanged observations.
side_review: Oblique rendered review confirmed closed main envelope and roof continuity. Assumed attic screen extended down to main roof after this review.
remaining_visual_mismatch: Inspected full 1920x1285 comparison and oblique draft. Main facade proportions, 11-bay rhythm, portico silhouette, roof balustrade and viewpoint are consistent with source. Carved detail and landscaping are simplified; illumination is flatter and cooler, entrance fanlight joinery approximate, and missing left tree changes occlusion. Scale and rear geometry are assumptions. This is a useful exterior reconstruction, not a photoreal or surveyed replica.
